newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Lawton Water Authority, Okla.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Lawton Water Authority, Okla.

text.p: Sales Tax and Utility System Sales Tax and Utility
Revenue Bonds, Series 1996 Revenue Bonds, Series 1997
The Lawton Water Authority, Lawton, Oklahoma (the

Authority''), will receive sealed bids on the 17th day of December, 1996, at 5:00 o'clock p.m., Central Standard Time, in the Office of the Finance Director, City Hall, 103 S.W. 4th Street, Lawton, Oklahoma 73501, for the purchase of the bonds designated as the Lawton Water Authority Sales Tax and Utility Revenue Bonds, Series 1996 (the Series 1996 Bonds''), and the Lawton Water Authority Sales Tax and Utility System Revenue Bonds, Series 1997 (the Series 1997 Bonds ), hereinafter collectively referred to as the Bonds'', in accordance with the terms of a Notice of Sale. The Bids will be presented and awarded at a meeting of the Board of Trustees on December 17, 1996, at 6:00 p.m.

The Series 1996 Bonds are to be dated December 15, 1996, and the Series 1997 Bonds are to be dated January 1, 1997, and will be serial bonds due semi-annual on July 1 and January 1, in each of the years and in the principal amounts as follows:

Interest will be payable July 1, 1997 and semi-annually each January 1 and July 1 thereafter.Principal and interest on the Bonds will be payable by Bank of Oklahoma, N.A., as registrar and corporate trustee.The Bonds will be issued as fully registered bonds in $5,000 denominations or, with respect to principal maturing on the same date, integral multiples thereof. The Bonds are not subject to redemption prior to maturity.
Bidders must specify the rate of interest the Bonds will bear in multiples of one-eighth (1/8th) or one-twentieth (1/20th) of one percent (1%) per annum. Bidders are not

restricted as to the number of rates that may be provided that only one single rate shall be specified for all Bonds of the same maturity. THE SPREAD BETWEEN THE HIGHEST AND LOWEST INTEREST RATE SHALL NOT EXCEED TWO PERCENT (2%)

The Series 1996 Bonds will be sold in one block, all or none. The Series 1997 Bonds will be sold in one block, all or none. No bid of less than par value and accrued interest to the date of delivery and payment therefor will be considered. The award, if any, will be made to the bidder offering to purchase the Bonds at the lowest net interest cost to the Authority. The Authority reserves the right, to the extent not prohibited by law, to reject any or all proposals, and to waive any irregularity or informality in any bid.
Official Bid Form and Good Faith Check
The bid for each series of Bonds must be submitted in duplicate without deviation on the Official Bid Form
furnished the Authority and each bid shall be enclosed in a separate sealed envelope address to the Lawton Water
Authority. Each bid shall be marked

Authority Sales Tax and Utility System Revenue Bonds, Series 1996'', and must be accompanied by a Certified or Cashier's Check payable to the Lawton Water Authority in the amount of $200,000 which is equal to two percent (2%) of the principal amount of the Series 1996 Bonds to be issued, and Bid for Lawton Water Authority Sales Tax and Utility System Revenue Bonds, Series 1997'', and must be accompanied by a Certified or Cashier's Check payable to the Lawton Water Authority in the amount of $200,000.00 which is equal two percent (2%) of the principal amount of the Series 1997 Bonds to be issued.
Delivery of and Payment for the Bonds

Delivery of the Series 1996 Bonds will be made on or about December 27, 1996. and delivery of the Series 1997 Bonds will be made on or about January 10, 1997. Delivery of the Bonds will be made in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, or at such other place as may be mutually agreed upon.

The unqualified approving opinion of Fagin, Brown, Bush, Tinney & Kiser, Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, will be furnished by the Authority without expense to the purchaser. Further information with respect to this issue of Bonds may be obtained from the Financial Consultant to the Authority, Leo Oppenheim & Co., Inc. 101 Park Avenue, Suite 900, Oklahoma City, Oklahoma 73102, Telephone (405) 235-7100.
